record.field: Confirm customer identity, contact details and communication preferences. Keep clinical information in restricted records. Avoid duplicate contacts.
Authorized clinical staff verify the source prescription, patient, examination date, both eyes and validity. Approve and retain an immutable version; revisions create a new version.
Scan the physical serial, check SKU/colour/size/condition and native availability. For a customer-owned frame record identifying details, condition and suitability. Do not create company stock.
An authorized practitioner records both lenses, monocular PD, fitting heights and laboratory instructions. Verify units and measurements against the patient and chosen frame.
Use Odoo Sales. Explain scope and terms, record customer acceptance and apply approved pricing. Confirm the quotation and record deposits/payment through native invoicing.
Create one optical job for each pair. Link the patient, confirmed order, exact frame sale line and physical serial. Link the approved prescription in Restricted specifications.

Verify patient/job/frame identity; verify approved prescription and both lens specifications; verify measurements and lab instructions; inspect the frame condition. Record all four checks and outcome. Failed checks block ordering.
Use native Purchase for supplier RFQ/PO, receipt and bill. Confirm optical pre-lab verification before ordering. Record landed costs through Odoo Inventory/Accounting where applicable.
Scan the job and exact physical frame. Link and validate the native internal transfer to the company-owned stock location at the external lab. Link the confirmed lab PO. Preserve company ownership.

Use native receipts for bought goods and an internal transfer for returning company-owned frames. Verify serial, quantity, condition and supplier reference. Log differences and do not silently substitute frames.

Scan job and frame again on receipt. Verify identity; verify right/left lenses against the approved prescription and instructions; document lens/measurement verification; inspect frame and lens condition. Failures stay on hold.

Scan job and frame at final fitting. Verify customer identity, prescription/lens match, fit/measurements and condition/safety. Record the dispensing check. Verify native payment and delivery; obtain customer collection confirmation.

Open an exception against the original job. Document responsibility, resolution and native cost/stock treatment. Manager approves before a separate replacement job is created. Preserve the original clinical and operational history.
Check the recorded dispensing date, warranty terms and issue. Record the customer communication and approved remedy. Use native returns and credit notes. Do not promise an unapproved warranty period.

Receive and count using native Inventory. Every optical frame uses serial tracking and a distinct optical scan code. Print labels and verify scanner output. Use native stock adjustments, transfers and returns with authorized staff.

Reconcile native POS/cash/bank/accounting totals. Review uncollected jobs, unresolved exceptions, native stock discrepancies and unmatched deposits. Record variance responsibility and follow-up; never maintain a parallel optical ledger.
